scripts.check: bun run gen && wrangler types -c core/wrangler.prod.jsonc ./worker-configuration.d.ts >/dev/null && tsc -p . && svelte-check --tsconfig ./web/tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.lint: git submodule update --init --quiet tools/anti-slop && biome check . && oxlint
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run copy-check && bun run test
scripts.deploy:prod: bun run build && wrangler deploy -c core/wrangler.prod.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.prod.jsonc
